component.name: Lumen400
component.summary: Modern, 100% standalone pure-Rust GPU-accelerated media player
Lecteur multimédia moderne 100 % Rust autonome accéléré par le GPU

description.p: Lumen400 is an independent, 100% standalone media player written in safe Rust (#![forbid(unsafe_code)]) with wgpu, egui and cpal, featuring a lock-free audio master clock, GPU HDR10/HLG-to-SDR tone mapping, native bwdif deinterlacing, a 10-band equalizer, WSOLA pitch-preserving playback speeds, and text/bitmap subtitles.
